response.final_analysis: After evaluating each substance listed, it is clear that all are secreted by the stomach. Gastric lipase, though less known than pancreatic lipase, is secreted by the stomach and aids in fat digestion. Pepsinogens and HCl are fundamental to protein digestion and maintaining stomach pH. Thus, all options are secreted by the stomach.
